We have been working on NearPrime VR for 3 years. NearPrime VR takes place in the near future cyberpunk world where super powers battle for next-gen technology - cyborg technology.

Walk through the cyberpunk world of NearPrime VR and explore the story of love and betrayal, good and evil, sacrifice and greed.
